title: Uniformity.
bodyText: This part shall be interpreted and construed in the manner best able to effectuate the general purposes of attaining uniformity in the laws of the State, and with the laws of other states and the United States.
bodyHtml: [§200-35]  Uniformity.  This part shall be interpreted and construed in the manner best able to effectuate the general purposes of attaining uniformity in the laws of the State, and with the laws of other states and the United States. [L 1991, c 272, pt of §2]
